mapper.sql: drug_id AS drugId, drug_name AS drugName, drug_type AS drugType, indication, applicable_department AS applicableDepartment, dosage_form AS dosageForm, specification, manufacturer, unit_price AS unitPrice, stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM drug ORDER BY drug_name ASC
SELECT FROM drug ORDER BY drug_name ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM drug WHERE drug_id = #{drugId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drug(drug_name, drug_type, indication, applicable_department, dosage_form, specification, manufacturer, unit_price, stock_quantity, status) VALUES(#{drugName}, #{drugType}, #{indication}, #{applicableDepartment}, #{dosageForm}, #{specification}, #{manufacturer}, #{unitPrice}, #{stockQuantity}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE drug SET drug_name = #{drugName}, drug_type = #{drugType}, indication = #{indication}, applicable_department = #{applicableDepartment}, dosage_form = #{dosageForm}, specification = #{specification}, manufacturer = #{manufacturer}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, stock_quantity = #{stockQuantity}, status = #{status} WHERE drug_id = #{drugId}
